def.name: learn.header
def.title: Learn heading
def.description: The Learn page's heading: what it shows, and ↻ to read every figure on the page again.
def.template: <row gap=2 align=center wrap=true><col gap=1 fill=true><heading level=2>Your learning</heading><text tone=muted>All your courses at a glance — what you know, what is due, how you are doing.</text></col><button action="reload" label="↻" tip="Reload" variant=quiet/></row>

def.name: learn.stat
def.title: Learn figure
def.description: One figure over every course, as a tile: steps mastered, cards due, cards known, streak, XP today, XP this week, exercises done or level.

params.name: metric
params.help: which figure: steps, due, known, streak, xp-today, xp-week, exercises, level

def.template:
<data name="dash" flow="learn.dashboard"/>
{{#if data.dash.totals}}
<let name="tt" value="data.dash.totals"/>
{{#if props.metric == 'steps'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Steps mastered</muted></small><heading level=2>{{ tt.mastered }} / {{ tt.steps }}</heading><progress value="{{ tt.percent }}" max=100 tone=good/><small><muted>{{ tt.percent }}% · {{ tt.begun }} in progress</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'due'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Cards due today</muted></small><heading level=2>🃏 {{ tt.due }}</heading><small><muted>of {{ tt.cards }} cards</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'known'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Cards you know well</muted></small><heading level=2>{{ tt.knownPercent }}%</heading><progress value="{{ tt.knownPercent }}" max=100 tone=info/><small><muted>{{ tt.known }} in stacks 3 and 4</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'streak'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Streak</muted></small><heading level=2>🔥 {{ tt.streak }}</heading><small><muted>days in a row</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'xp-today'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>XP today</muted></small><heading level=2>{{ tt.todayXp }}</heading><progress value="{{ tt.todayPercent }}" max=100 tone="{{ tt.todayPercent >= 100 ? 'good' : 'warn' }}"/><small><muted>goal {{ tt.dailyGoal }} XP</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'xp-week'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>XP this week</muted></small><heading level=2>{{ tt.week }}</heading><sparkline values="{{ data.dash.last14 }}" wide=true/><small><muted>{{#if tt.weekTrend >= 0}}▲ {{ tt.weekTrend }}{{#else}}▼ {{ 0 - tt.weekTrend }}{{/if}} on the week before</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'exercises'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Exercises done</muted></small><heading level=2>🧪 {{ tt.exercisesDone }} / {{ tt.exercises }}</heading><small><muted>{{ tt.avgBest }}% on average · {{ tt.triesWeek }} tries this week</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#if props.metric == 'level'}}<box><col gap=1><small><muted>Level</muted></small><heading level=2>⭐ {{ tt.level }}</heading><small><muted>{{ tt.xp }} XP in all · {{ tt.ready }} of {{ tt.courses }} courses ready</muted></small></col></box>{{/if}}
{{#else}}
<box><col gap=1><small><muted>…</muted></small><heading level=2>…</heading></col></box>
{{/if}}

def.name: learn.xp-days
def.title: Learn XP per day
def.description: The XP earned per day over every course, as a heatmap.
def.template:
<data name="dash" flow="learn.dashboard"/>
<box title="XP per day"><heatmap source="data.dash.days" date="day" value="xp" calc="sum" weeks="{{ props.weeks }}" label="XP per day" unit="XP"/></box>

def.name: learn.stacks
def.title: Learn cards by stack
def.description: Your cards by stack: how many come back every day, every 3 days, every week, every 3 weeks.
def.template: {{#each data.dash.stacks}} Stack {{ box }}{{#if box == 1}}every day{{/if}}{{#if box == 2}}every 3 days{{/if}}{{#if box == 3}}every week{{/if}}{{#if box == 4}}every 3 weeks{{/if}}{{ n }} {{/each}} Stack 1 comes back every day, stack 4 every 3 weeks — the further right, the better you know them.

def.name: learn.course-lines
def.title: Learn courses
def.description: One line per course: its level, XP, streak, cards due and how far it is.
def.template: {{#each data.dash.courses}} {{ title }}{{#if status == 'ready'}}Level {{ level }}{{/if}}{{#if status == 'researching'}}being planned{{/if}}{{#if status == 'failed'}}planning failed{{/if}}{{ xp }} XP{{#if streak}} · 🔥 {{ streak }}{{/if}}{{#if due}} · 🃏 {{ due }} due{{/if}} {{#if status == 'ready'}} {{ mastered }} of {{ steps }} steps · {{ cards }} cards{{#if todayXp}} · {{ todayXp }} / {{ dailyGoal }} XP today{{/if}}{{/if}} {{/each}} {{#if data.dash.totals}}{{#if !data.dash.courses}}{{/if}}{{/if}}

def.name: learn.overview
def.title: Learn overview
def.description: Every course at a glance: steps mastered, cards due and by stack, streak, XP today and this week, exercises, XP per day, one line per course — all in one block (learn.header, learn.stat, learn.xp-days, learn.stacks and learn.course-lines are its parts, each a block of its own).
def.template:
<col gap=5>
<use block="learn.header"/>
<grid cols=4 gap=3 min=170>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="steps"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="due"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="known"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="streak"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="xp-today"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="xp-week"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="exercises"/>
<use block="learn.stat" metric="level"/>
</grid>
<grid cols=2 gap=4 min=320>
<use block="learn.xp-days"/>
<use block="learn.stacks"/>
</grid>
<use block="learn.course-lines"/>
</col>
